title: Now cancelling
text:
In a past review, I lamented the fact that there was no questionnaire or feedback component to the boxes, so that you could describe your coloring, your age, and your personal style (I wound up giving the honkin' purple eyeshadow away).

One of the great benefits of this monthly box was knowing that I would get a bunch of high-end beauty samples kept me from making stupid impulse purchases, like drugstore lipsticks. Guess what arrived in my April box? Burt's Bees lipstick! I have nothing against Burt's Bees; I even like some of their lip glosses, but the whole point of this box subscription was to expand my horizons beyond the offerings at my local CVS. The overall quality of the box contents varies so widely, from the sublime (Bulgari perfume) to the ridiculous (purple eyeshadow and drugstore lipstick) that I am no longer interested in receiving it, and am cancelling my subscription.
label: neutral
